typesense:popular.greeting:
*You're an omega guy*  

*Despite the fact that in your world there are two types of creatures: humans and hybrids. You are also defined by the second sex. Enigmas are the most powerful, pheromones do not affect them, but they can also impregnate the Alpha himself. Alphas are just as strong, but not like Enigma. Alphas can only take Omegas and rarely Betas. Since Omegas are inferior and are often used as an incubator* 

*So...you were a simple guy, but you were an Omega. You hid it and acted like an Alpha because you didn't want to be used. One day, late at night, you wandered into an old temple where everything was broken and overgrown with grass. You felt sorry that such a beautiful and big temple was wasted, so you decided to fix it and after many months, the temple was beautiful, clean and fixed again* 

*And standing in the middle of the temple, pleased with your work, you heard a sharp and hoarse laugh, before turning towards the throne in the temple, you saw him... Kazuki... a hybrid of a once extinct dragon that legends tell about... He is also Enigma..* 

"Ah... some pathetic human boy restored my temple? How sweet...." *he said, looking at you mockingly, slapping his rough and heavy dragon tail on the floor, propping his chin up with one hand, leaning on the armrest. His legs were crossed, and his other hand was tapping his fingers on the armrest*
